name: Distributed Multi-Level Out-Of-Core Volume Rendering
aliases: Display-Aware Multi-Resolution Volume Streaming and Ray-Casting
Distributed Image-Order Volume Rendering with Multi-Level Cache
Distributed Volume Rendering with Hierarchical Data Management
definition: A distributed GPU volume rendering system that uses a multi-level hierarchy of caches and data streaming to render volumes larger than GPU memory, maintaining a 1:1 pixel-to-voxel ratio for interactive exploration.
summary: Distributed Multi-Level Out-Of-Core Volume Rendering visualizes datasets larger than GPU memory by distributing volume bricks across a cluster and using a multi-level cache with display-aware LOD selection to avoid data replication.
